headline: Fogelman in active expansion mode: Dallas portfolio growth and talent scaling creates onboarding and Mystery Shopping opportunity

signals.summary: Fogelman acquired its ninth Texas property in the Dallas suburbs (Ovilla at Legacy Square), signaling continued geographic and portfolio growth beyond its Memphis core.
signals.suggestedAction: Schedule a call with Pattie Woods to confirm onboarding timeline for the new Dallas property to PerformanceHQ (Training, Policies, Mystery Shopping). Offer a turnkey Capture Wizard training build for the new team, leveraging existing playbooks, and confirm Mystery Shopping coverage is active within 60 days of opening.
